name: Inside AI
tagline: Learn it. Build it. Explain it.
description: Public AI study notes, model explainers and sourced world AI updates by Somil Singh.

articles.title: How VAEs Learn to Generate New Images
articles.description: An encoder, a decoder and a space between them. See how a VAE trains and generates, with diagrams, PyTorch and actual output.
articles.image_alt: VAE overview illustration from the published article

articles.title: Why a VAE Needs KL Divergence, Variational Inference and a Little Noise
articles.description: Read Part 01 first, then unpack the maths behind its code: KL divergence, the ELBO and reparameterization, with numerical checks.
articles.image_alt: Concept map showing the mathematical foundations behind a VAE

articles.title: How a VQ VAE turns an image into a code from a learned dictionary
articles.description: Choosing an image code is one problem. Learning which codes to sample is another. Codebook selection, gradient routes and a recorded PyTorch experiment.
articles.image_alt: Encoder output chooses a learned code and the decoder reconstructs; a separate prior samples the codes.

articles.title: The VQ VAE gradient trick: what learns when a code is selected?
articles.description: Trace nearest code selection, stop gradients, commitment and discrete priors with six visual notes and a small reproducible VQ VAE gradient check.
articles.image_alt: A continuous encoder vector selects a discrete code while a surrogate sends learning information back

articles.title: How a GAN learns to turn noise into samples
articles.description: Trace GAN generator and discriminator updates, detach and input gradients. Inspect a reproducible four cluster example with recorded output and clear limits.
articles.image_alt: Two panels contrast input reconstruction with GAN generation from noise and discriminator feedback.

articles.title: Why a GAN can reject a fake and still teach almost nothing
articles.description: Compare the two generator objectives, derive the ideal discriminator and inspect a recorded numerical gradient check with six original figures.
articles.image_alt: A rejected fake has two different local gradient strengths

articles.title: How a diffusion model learns to turn noise into four clusters
articles.description: Train a small diffusion model, generate 4,096 points and inspect its limits with six figures, three code steps and the recorded CPU output.
articles.image_alt: Known data plus deliberate noise gives a supervised noise target

articles.title: Why predicting noise gives a diffusion model a reverse step
articles.description: Derive one reverse distribution and check the gradient with actual numbers. Then remove the clean point and see what the model has to learn instead.
articles.image_alt: Known training target and learned generation estimate
